# Nene's Restaurant & Bar

> Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Khinkali, khachapuri and Chicken Kyiv, brought out by a staff that loves explaining the menu.

- Address: 4328 W El Prado Blvd, Tampa, FL 33629
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Khinkali; Adjaruli khachapuri; Caucasian lamb racks
